userSpecifiedSources:
Original source products and archive services:

- [NOAA/NWS SPC tornado database](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/wcm/#data).
- [NOAA NCEI Storm Events](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/stormevents/).
- [NOAA Event Footprint Catalog](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/event-footprint-catalog), incorporating DAT and Storm Events.
- [Census Population Estimates Program](https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest.html).
- [Census 2020 cartographic boundaries](https://www.census.gov/geographies/mapping-files/2020/geo/carto-boundary-file.html).
- [NOAA NCEI SWDI](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/swdiws/), NEXRAD-derived products.
- [Iowa Environmental Mesonet warning archive](https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/request/gis/watchwarn.phtml), archiving NWS warning products.
- [USGS Annual NLCD](https://www.usgs.gov/centers/eros/science/annual-nlcd-data-access).

Fixed 2010–2025 snapshot; no scheduled refresh. The release preserves source URLs, timestamps, hashes and extracted records. NLCD has 17 documented coverage gaps. ERA5 and ACS/TIGER tract data are deferred. Code and release receipts: https://github.com/jakeryderv/us-tornado-data-2010-2025

fields.description: SPC end converted using its fixed source time-zone code.

fields.name: interval_gap_minutes
fields.description: Nonnegative separation between source and SPC time intervals, in minutes.

fields.name: interval_outside_minutes
fields.description: Maximum extension of source interval outside SPC interval, in minutes.

fields.name: start_delta_minutes
fields.description: Absolute source/SPC start-time difference in minutes; diagnostic only.

fields.name: geometry_gap_km
fields.description: Minimum source-geometry to SPC endpoint-track distance, kilometers.

fields.name: source_extent_distance_km
fields.description: Maximum source-vertex distance to the SPC endpoint track, kilometers.

fields.name: plausible
fields.description: Passes wider 10-minute and 5-km ambiguity guard.

fields.name: evidence_score
fields.description: Interval extension / 10 plus directed distance / 5. Lower is closer; not a probability.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: High only for accepted rule-based links; none otherwise. Not measured precision.

fields.name: evidence_tier
fields.description: Strong, borderline, weak or none based on time/geometry evidence.

fields.name: candidate_rank
fields.description: One-based evidence-score order within source record; null with no candidates.

fields.name: candidate_count
fields.description: Number of broad-window SPC candidates for this source record.

fields.name: plausible_candidate_count
fields.description: Number passing the wider ambiguity guard; acceptance requires exactly one.

fields.name: accepted
fields.description: True only for unique, eligible, strict time/geometry links that pass family checks.

fields.name: match_status
fields.description: Accepted, ambiguous, review_required, outside_acceptance or unmatched.

fields.name: decision_reason
fields.description: Reason for acceptance or withheld acceptance.

EF target, normalized onset/location, pre-cutoff radar aggregates, warning counts/lead time and missingness. Release v2.2.0: one row per tornado, 20,164 rows and 30 columns. Use ml/feature_dictionary.json to select the 15 onset predictor candidates; targets, IDs and metadata are not predictors. Reported onset/location are hindsight anchors, radar latency is assumed to be five minutes, and warning cancellation coverage is incomplete. Unknown EF targets remain missing. Join linked source tables using tornado_id.

Onset fields plus final track/impact data, radar through onset +60 minutes and land-cover summaries. Release v2.2.0: one row per tornado, 20,164 rows and 53 columns. This view supports retrospective EF-rating analysis. Final path dimensions, damage/impact fields and footprint-dependent NLCD summaries are post-event information and must not enter onset forecasts. Land cover uses prior-year Annual NLCD at native 30 m resolution; 17 events are outside selected coverage. Unknown EF targets and missing values are preserved. Use ml/feature_dictionary.json for field roles and join source evidence by tornado_id.
